rules: Only receipts conforming to human-design-authority-decision.candidate.v1.schema.json may close an entry.
Generic continue/proceed instructions are not policy approval.
Safe floors remain effective while a decision is OPEN or HOLD.

rows.safe_floor: Disputed/unavailable oracle => HOLD; validator cannot self-approve changed oracle.
Invalid corpus material cannot silently remain eligible; derived impact must be traced.
Missing rights/purpose basis blocks secondary use.
No current target authorization => active external-effect test BLOCKED.
Competing heads => HOLD; losing head preserved.
Exit cannot close until data/key/evidence continuity is verified.
Ambiguous business-time binding cannot support time-sensitive positive claim.
Product purchase never implies authority to actively test an unowned target.

rows.topic: Organization transfer dual-control and authority rebinding
rows.safe_floor: Tenant rename cannot transfer authority; explicit rebinding/requalification required.
Recipient/purpose authority and custody provenance required.
Simulation/sandbox default; production effect requires explicit high-risk authority and reconciliation.
No cross-tenant aggregation promotion when isolation/consent authority is unresolved.

rows.topic: Reviewer Diversity versus Qualified Reviewer Scarcity
rows.safe_floor: Do not lower qualification or independence floor merely to satisfy diversity/quorum.

rows.topic: Explanation Fidelity versus Sealed Challenge Secrecy
rows.safe_floor: Challenge secrecy cannot be broken to strengthen explanation; unresolved tradeoff remains HOLD.
Offline uncertainty cannot be represented as current; emergency authority cannot bypass residency constraints.
